borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Erection of a front and rear roof extension, including raising the front party wall height, installation of 3no. rooflights in the front roofslope, erection of a single dormer door and a dormer French door with a Juliette balcony to the rear elevation; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side of existing back addition; removal of a chimney and part of the pitched roof to form a new flat roof, and erection of 1.7m high obscure glazed screening to the side and rear elevation, in connection with its use as a roof terrace to the rear elevation at second floor level; bricking-up 1no. window to the side elevation, and installation of a new French door with a Juliette balcony following the removal of an existing window to the rear elevation of first floor back addition; bricking-up 1no. window, and installation of new bi-folding doors following the removal of an existing window to the rear elevation at ground floor level.
